mapping.draft_py:
# Sorin's Thirst: "Sorin's Thirst deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life."
# "X and you gain N life" is Seq(X, GAIN_LIFE) (Spirit of Malevolence, Scavenging Ooze); the damage
# step is Silent Dart's DEAL_DAMAGE to target creature.
effect = Seq(steps=(
    A(Verb.DEAL_DAMAGE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=2),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
    A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=2), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
))
abilities = [SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.INSTANT, effect=effect)]

clauses.clause: Sorin's Thirst deals 2 damage to target creature and you gain 2 life.
Sorin's Thirst deals 2 damage to target creature
clauses.evidence: target slot (cast) 1..1 of the six creatures only (no artifact, enchantment or player); each [cast targets=[X]]: 'X is dealt 2 damage (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)' (you_bear, opp_flier, opp_bear die; the 4/4s and 3/3 keep 2 damage until the turn ends).
every variant: 'you gains 2 life (by card/GAIN_LIFE)', you: life 20 -> 22; cost B-2.
